text:
Lena D: spotted an a11y regression on the top toolbar search dropdown - VoiceOver doesn't announce the open/closed state reliably.
Marco (Eng): that's probably because we toggle visibility with CSS only and don't update aria-expanded. currently it's `div[role=menu]` with `hidden` class toggled.
Sam T: quick fix: set `aria-expanded=true/false` on the button that controls the dropdown. also ensure the menu has `aria-labelledby` pointing to the button id.
Lena D: also keyboard focus lands inside the menu but focus-ring is clipped by overflow: hidden on the toolbar container. We need to avoid clipping on focus.
Jin - QA: i can add a regression test in Playwright to check aria-expanded toggles and focus visibility.
A11yBot: automated scan: 2 violations (aria-expanded missing, focus clipping).
Marco (Eng): proposed PR will add proper aria attributes and adjust `overflow: visible` during focus state. will test in Safari/VoiceOver.
Lena D: also nit on visible labels: placeholder-only search icon doesn't have accessible name. recommend adding `aria-label="Search models"` on the input.
Sam T: agree. also add `role="search"` on the form for semantics.
Jin - QA: test plan: Playwright should toggle the button, assert `aria-expanded` changes, and verify menu item is focused.
Lena D: follow-ups: Marco to open PR with aria-expanded + overflow tweak (D: 1 day), Jin to add test (D: 1 day), Sam to run SR check.
Marco (Eng): will also add a small CSS token to ensure focus ring has `z-index` above overflowed container when necessary.
A11yBot: note: baseline updated at /tests/fixtures/toolbar-aria-baseline.json
Sam T: thanks - small patch should be quick. :rocket:
